changelog: Bulk Transfer now verifies the selected primary rep, sales role, contribution, and every enabled guardrail before Save.
Bulk Transfer preserves completed results after interruptions and distinguishes Not saved, Saved with discrepancy, Needs verification, and Not processed outcomes.
Added bounded post-save verification retries that read saved values without repeating Save or automatically retrying uncertain transfers.
Added batch-result recovery after a lost response or page refresh, with local diagnostics and protection against resubmitting an already-used batch ID.
Normal confirmed retries now exclude completed records; explicitly changed guardrails can still be reapplied to the reviewed batch after uncertain outcomes are resolved.
Improved FlowBot recognition of everyday workflow terminology and refreshed its bundled app guide for Bulk Transfer recovery.
